summary: Creates table repo with required columns

precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)

execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "repo" (
  "createdAt" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),
  "defaultRef" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "source" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  UNIQUE ("source")
)

postcheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)
